title: TranscriptEventV1 (internal domain contract)
description: One normalized transcript event emitted by the native transcript owner (engine/crates/membrane-transcript). Internal Adapt-domain contract; NOT one of Membrane's five public protocol shapes (ScopeGrantV1, ContextCandidateSetV1, ContextPacketV1, ContextReceiptV1, KnowledgeEmissionV1). Frozen by migration spec N1; field names mirror the retired Python normalizer exactly, including snake_case call_id.

eventId.description: evt_ + sha256(canonical seed)[:32]; deterministic under T-04.

byteStart.description: Source byte span start; slicing [byteStart..byteEnd] reproduces the row exactly (T-01).

blockIndex.description: Index within its row; multi-block rows emit several events.

sequence.description: Global 1-based emission order over the whole transcript.

occurrence.description: Per-call_id occurrence counter (0-based); later results never trample earlier ones.

toolCallEventId.description: For tool_result: eventId of the matching tool_call when already seen.

class.description: Alias of classification (compat with the retired Python surface).

parserDigest.description: Parser version receipt; cached extraction invalidates on change (T-06).
